def analyze(O,n):
    cyc=list(range(1,n+1))
    offs=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(O):
        ok=None
        for off in range(n):
            if all(row[j]==cyc[(j-off)%n] for j in range(len(row))):
                ok=off; break
        offs.append(ok)
    return offs
print('demo offs (n=6):',analyze(O,6))
